stemMd: A supplier promises that a new package will reduce breakage enough to justify a higher unit price. Which question best tests the promise?

options.label: A
options.textMd: How many words are printed on the package?

options.label: B
options.textMd: What is the value of avoided breakage per shipped unit compared with the extra packaging cost per unit?

options.label: C
options.textMd: Was the package name chosen by a committee?

options.label: D
options.textMd: Is the package displayed at trade shows?

options.label: E
options.textMd: Does the supplier also sell unrelated office supplies?

explanationMd: Both benefit and added cost must be placed on the same per-unit basis. Their comparison can directly support or undermine the financial claim.

distractorRationale.c: Naming procedure is irrelevant to breakage economics.
distractorRationale.a: Text length does not quantify the proposed saving.
distractorRationale.e: Other product lines do not settle this cost comparison.
distractorRationale.d: Promotion does not establish economic performance.
